mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (member_id, board_type, title, content, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{boardType}, #{title}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id, b.board_type, b.title, m.nickname, b.created_at FROM board b JOIN member m ON b.member_id = m.member_id ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.board_id DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board b JOIN member m ON b.member_id = m.member_id
AND b.board_type = #{boardType}
AND m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND b.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND ( b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT b.board_id, b.board_type, b.title, m.nickname, b.view_count, b.created_at, b.updated_at, COUNT(DISTINCT c.comment_id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT bl.like_id) AS like_count
FROM board b
JOIN member m ON b.member_id = m.member_id
LEFT JOIN comment c ON b.board_id = c.board_id
LEFT JOIN board_like bl ON b.board_id = bl.board_id
AND b.board_type = #{boardType}
AND m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND b.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND ( b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
GROUP BY b.board_id, b.board_type, b.title, m.nickname, b.view_count, b.created_at, b.updated_at
ORDER BY b.view_count DESC, b.board_id DESC
ORDER BY comment_count DESC, b.board_id DESC
ORDER BY like_count DESC, b.board_id DESC
ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.board_id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.board_id, b.member_id, b.board_type, b.title, b.content, m.nickname, b.view_count, b.created_at, b.updated_at FROM board b JOIN member m ON b.member_id = m.member_id WHERE b.board_id = #{boardId}
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET view_count = view_count + 1, updated_at = updated_at WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id, b.title FROM board b WHERE b.board_id < #{boardId} ORDER BY b.board_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT b.board_id, b.title FROM board b WHERE b.board_id > #{boardId} ORDER BY b.board_id LIMIT 1
